page.layout: One page of text in a single column. Running head at the top centre. Page number at the top right. Marginal notes in the right margin, beside the lines "Ægyptia-", "ea nomina" and "mensium". Gathering signature at the foot right.

main_text.p: inter se colloquio multa etiam Porphyrius tradit, in libris de abstinendo ab animatis. Sed absurdum videtur quod scribit Clemens de brutis in genere, tanquam omnia dialecto quadam inter se utantur, scorpii, quoqué & pisces: quibus cum ipsa vox negata sit, multo magis etiam dialectum negatam fateamur oportet.
main_text.head: CAPUT II.

head.i: De Linguis diuersis singillatim, per totum terrarum orbem, ordine literarum Alphabethi.

main_text.p: ABASINORUM lingua eadem, quæ Æthiopica; quam vide suo loco.
¶ ABGAZORUM vel ABGAZELLO-RUM lingua eadem, quæ Gazarorum.

¶ ÆGYPTII Apostolos suâ dialecto loquentes audiunt Hierosolymis, in die Pentecostes, & admirantur. Lingua Colchis eadem, quæ Ægyptiis est, ut Eustathius scribit Dionysium Afrum enarrans. Mensium anni XII Ægyptiaca nomina hæc reperio, quæ omnia oxytona sunt: Tybi, Mechir, Phamenoth,mensium Pharmuthi, Pachon, Pauni, Epiphi, Mesori, Thoth, Paophi, Athyr, Choræ[?]. Nicolaus Myrepsus Alexandrinus antidoto 371. eadem mea

page.notes: Right margin notes, transcribed in place: "Ægyptia-" beside the line "XII Ægyptiaca", "ea nomina" beside "mnia oxytona", and "mensium" beside "Phamenoth". The reading of the note "ea nomina" is slightly uncertain. The last line "eadem mea" appears cut off by the page edge and probably continues on the next page. "Choræ" is uncertain; the last word is ornamented and hard to read. The "CAPUT II." heading is set in spaced capitals. The title below it is in italic. The large initial A of "ABASINORUM" is joined to the first word. Stains and show-through are ignored.
